name: Haku
source:
Finding himself collapsed in the middle of nowhere with barely any clothes on his back, he was rescued by Kuon and given a name.
Having lost his memories: his real identity is a mystery.
Neither hard-working nor earnest, his quick thinking is this young man's biggest asset.
